gloss: to organize; to put in order; to sort out

definitions.gloss: to organize; to put in order; to tidy up
definitions.explanation: To arrange things in a logical or orderly manner, whether physical objects on a desk, information for a report, or one's own thoughts and feelings.

definitions.gloss: to sort out; to consolidate; to dispose of what is unnecessary
definitions.explanation: To streamline by identifying and removing what is no longer needed, such as decluttering belongings, reducing staff, or eliminating redundant items.

notes:
A very common and versatile verb meaning to bring order to something or to dispose of what is unnecessary. Combines {整|せい} (arrange, put in order) and {理|り} (reason, logic).

USAGE:
- Sense 1 focuses on arranging or ordering things: physical objects, information, thoughts
- Sense 2 focuses on streamlining by removing the unnecessary: decluttering, downsizing
- ⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧ (staff reduction) is a euphemism for layoffs
- {気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整理|せいり}する means to sort out one's feelings

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整理|せいり}する: to sort out one's feelings
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整理|せいり}する: to organize information
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整理|せいり}する: to sort through belongings
- ⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧: staff reduction, downsizing
- ⟦{整理|せいり}{整頓|せいとん}→整理整頓：08423_seiriseiton⟧: tidying up and organizing (set phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧づける: to tidy up, to clean up — more casual and physical
- ⟦{整頓|せいとん}する→整頓する：20153_seitonsuru⟧: to put things in order — focuses on neatness and arrangement
- ⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to compile, to put together — focuses on bringing things together into a unified whole
- ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}する→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧: to classify, to categorize — focuses on sorting into categories
